paragraphs: I'm applying for the Sr Associate, Strategic Finance role at Uber in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I like that one application here reaches FP&A teams across Mobility, Delivery and Corporate Finance, because the work sits right next to how the business decides where to grow.

At Lenovo I was a Senior Business Analyst for two years, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I worked with finance teams on monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built models to evaluate $10M of marketing-channel budget and quantify ROI.
That lines up with building forecasts and operating goals with business leaders, breaking a messy question into a model, and turning it into a clear recommendation. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
